MEMORANDUM FOR RECORD

11 June 2026 SUBJECT: Urgent Market Research Memorandum (MRM) and Sole Source Justification (SSJ) Procurement of Computed Tomography (CT) Contrast for Naval Medical Center Camp Lejeune

(NMCCL)

BLUF: This MRM documents the urgent and compelling need to award a sole-source contract to Tri-Pharma for a 3-month supply of CT contrast. Due to a massive manufacturer recall on March 24, 2026, the prime vendor supply chain is crippled. Failure to award this requirement by the need-by date will force NMCCL to divert severe blunt trauma, penetrating trauma, and acute vascular emergencies, posing a severe risk to warfighter and patient safety.

1. Requirement Description Naval Medical Center Camp Lejeune (NMCCL), NC has an urgent and critical requirement for a 3-month supply of CT contrast. This agent is a life-saving diagnostic necessity for the Radiology and Emergency departments to evaluate acute trauma, vascular compromises, and other severe medical emergencies.

Small Business Size Standard: 1,300 employees North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 325412- Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing Product/Service Code: 6515 – Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and supplies Estimated Dollar Value of Acquisition

2. Background and Supply Chain Vulnerability The current market for CT contrast has been severely compromised due to a recent industry-wide disruption:

Factor Description of Impact Manufacturer Recall A widespread manufacturer recall issued on March 24, 2026, rendered existing supplies unusable and immediately crippled an already vulnerable supply chain. Prime Vendor Failure Standard prime vendor distribution channels are significantly backlogged. Existing orders are systematically being canceled due to the manufacturer's and distributors' inability to support the demand.
